description: Image Description: The image contains a single, simple graphical element resembling the number "4" rendered in a stylized, handwritten or sketch-like form. The digit is composed of two main strokes: a vertical line that curves slightly to the right at the top, and a horizontal line extending from the lower portion of the vertical stroke, forming a sharp angle. The lines are thin and appear to be drawn with a light, possibly digital pen or brush tool, giving it a minimalistic and abstract appearance.
